name: Osaka
summary: Osaka combines one of Japan's most celebrated food scenes with a significantly lower cost of living than Tokyo and world-class urban infrastructure, including ultra-fast internet and exceptional public transportation. It is one of the safest cities in the world to live and work, although the language barrier and visa bureaucracy remain real challenges for the digital nomad.
